selection.ownership: Avochato Inc., 203 Flamingo Road, Suite 501, Mill Valley, California 94941, United States. Reviewed edition is the public REST API at www.avochato.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Avochato REST API (auth_id and auth_secret query parameters, GET /v1/whoami, GET /v1/contacts, GET /v1/messages, GET /v1/messages/:id), Mill Valley / San Francisco operator identity, Settings > API Access credential generation, 429 rate limiting, and dated incident search for Avochato security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No current unresolved Avochato customer-account compromise is asserted. This is not a breach-free claim.

Official Avochato REST at https://www.avochato.com with auth_id/auth_secret query authentication, GET /v1/whoami as the cheap identity read, contact and message list/get, Mill Valley CA identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Writes, contact-id fanout, and inbox subdomain switching are omitted. No current unresolved customer-account compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v1/whoami (pinned credential validator).
Dual query auth uses http.auth for auth_id (setup apiKey) plus http.query auth_secret={{authSecret}}.
Native category is messaging rather than Communication/Marketing: Rust CATEGORIES has neither communication nor marketing bucket.

Returns raw provider JSON under data instead of the pinned {account,user,origin,createdAt} wrapper. GET omits Content-Type because the source only sets it when a JSON body is present. Upstream user-agent is not sent.
Optional afterPage and limit bind to official after_page and limit. Returns raw JSON under data instead of {contacts,nextPage,size}.

Optional query, page, direction, status, from, and to bind to documented query names. createdFrom and createdTo bind to created_at[from] and created_at[to] as in the pinned source. Returns raw JSON under data.
eventId is a URL-encoded path segment on GET /v1/messages/{eventId}. Returns raw JSON under data instead of {message}.
